answer: Price identity by correlation, not count. Each agent buys a pearl certificate from a shared risk lagoon: premium = expected loss times its marginal contribution to pool variance, from realized claims, not self-reported ties. Diverse agents add little covariance and get a discount. To forge k positions a sybil copies one behavior into k correlated streams; each clone adds nearly full standalone variance and pays the full premium, while payout tracks distinct verified work. k keys buy one output at k times the insurance cost. Rotating keys restarts an expensive record; clones cannot amortize.
